title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja
desc: Jugran kills a customs officer and a doctor, leaving their kids orphaned. As they grow up facing hardships, the children unite to take revenge on their parents' killer.

title: Khudgarz
desc: Sita raises Bihari and Amar like brothers. But Amar's father dislikes Bihari and tries to create a rift, threatening their bond and Sita's peaceful family.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

title: Kedarnath
desc: Mansoor, a gentle Muslim porter, falls for Mukku, the bold and free-spirited daughter of a Hindu priest. But their blossoming love is tested by deep misunderstandings and the fury of nature.

title: Awarapan
desc: Shivam, a hitman, is ordered to watch a woman. He finds out she's trapped in a trafficking ring and decides to help her reunite with her true love.

title: Singham Again
desc: Drawing parallels to the Ramayana, Bajirao Singham leads his team on a daring mission to rescue his wife while facing a powerful and mysterious enemy.

title: Kick
desc: Devi, addicted to adventures, breaks up with Shaina, a psychiatrist in Warsaw. His daredevil pursuits test love, freedom, and the cost of chasing thrill over stability.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das takes charge of India's hockey team post-independence and battles challenges and odds to lead them toward Olympic glory and bring pride to the nation.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, a down-on-his-luck man, learns his real father was a wealthy diamond merchant. But when he seeks his inheritance, he is shocked to find it has been left to a dog.

title: Sansar
desc: Din Dayal Sharma's daughter-in-law goes to live with her parents owing to her pregnancy. However, after returning, she finds out that her family is separated and tries to reunite them.

title: Traffic Signal
desc: Silsila, a street-smart young man who manages various trades at a Mumbai traffic signal, sees his life crumble when he unknowingly helps execute a murder.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.

title: Wanted
desc: A sharpshooter is trapped between a gangster who wants him dead, the police who seek his secrets, and a girlfriend who hopes he'll change his ways.

title: Dhadkan
desc: Anjali loves Dev, but family pressure forces her to marry Ram. Years later, Dev returns to win her back, only to find she has grown to love her husband.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: Commando - A One Man Army
desc: Karan, an Indian commando, is arrested by Chinese officials after a crash. Accused of spying, he must escape from their tough prison camp using all his skills.
